newsitem.title: UK: Med gasoline, gas oil up, other products flat.
newsitem.headline: Med gasoline, gas oil up, other products flat.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Monday.
Gasoline edged up $1 a tonne in line with Northwest Europe but activity was slow.
Dealers said there was good demand for low octane grades to meet Nigerian demand but saw little buying from the United States.
Naphtha was flat and quiet. Skikda loading was seen normal and the arbitrage to the East currently is unworkable, traders said.
Gas oil prices were firmer across the board as July benchmark IPE futures rallied $1.50 to close at $165.25 a tonne.
But spot market differentials were mostly unchanged with regional demand seen slack.
"The Mediterranean is certainly looking less promising than northwest Europe at the moment," said a trader.
High sulphur cargoes were unchanged in a quiet market and traders said not too many barrels were available after most of the ISAB material was snatched up by buyers.
A Spanish refiner picked up a high sulphur cargo from a European trader on Friday at below high cif plus $1, a little below the market.
There was unconfirmed talk that a trader sold a large cargo it was offering for a while out of Cartagena but there was no immediate indication of the level.
One percent was also quiet with a Spanish refiner said to be still offering a cargo but demand was said to be thin.
